page.overview:
Who is Nautilus?

Passive (baby, tamed, or in Peaceful difficulty)

A nautilus is a neutral tamable aquatic mob. It can be tamed using pufferfish, can be bred and fed using any fish or any type of fish bucket, equip with Nautilus Armor, and can be ridden on using a saddle.

Nautili usually spawn in all ocean biomes. Normally in groups of 1-2. Also in the ocean biomes, Baby Nautili can also spawn.

Nautili are passive to players and other mobs. They use their tentacles to propel forward in water. They cannot survive on land and suffocate unless pushed back into the water.
